input: Original question paired with body plus actual adjacent heading, never source path/title. Only complete untruncated pairs train or enter primary metrics.
target: direct=1; topic_only or irrelevant=0; partial and unjudgeable excluded. Provisional Codex coverage labels, not factual/human validation.
trainable: Last transformer block and classification head only; rest frozen. Separate safe numeric checkpoint, production weights untouched.
limits: Small synthetic supervised pilot; no search/gate promotion on training fit or familiar question improvements. No threshold, prompt, epoch or learning-rate tuning on heldout scores. Factual source correctness assessed separately.
